about: Malvek in the crypt entrance: the soul bolt from his palm stopped by the north wall and its burst, an aimed bolt (C5) stopped by a lantern post, the reap's spark; then walking into what stops a body (moveIn, at `radius`): stopped by a coffin, sliding along the reliquary and a lantern post, pressed against the shut crypt door, sliding along the wall until one of its piers holds him, stopped by the east wall, and sliding along the other coffin into the corner by the lever.
